entities.summary: Eben Christopher Upton is the Welsh founder and CEO of Raspberry Pi Holdings and the Raspberry Pi Foundation. He is responsible for the overall software and hardware architecture of the Raspberry Pi device. He is a former technical director and ASIC architect for Broadcom.
